messages:
Ava: quick async standup — what I did / blockers / today
Ava: did a run of the eu-west-1 prewarm job, validated that the new autoscale policy kicks at 65% GPU util. saw a few cold starts for t2-small instances.
Ava: blocker: still seeing occasional 502s from the legacy router when draining nodes during scale-down, not sure if it's healthcheck timing or LB config
Sam: re: 502s — can you paste the router logs when it happens? I pushed a tiny healthcheck tweak yesterday but might not have covered drain windows.
Ava: pasted snippet below from the time window (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T10:14:03Z] router: upstream fetch error: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-17T10:14:04Z] router: healthcheck failed: 503
[2026-03-17T10:14:05Z] autoscaler: scale_down triggered for pool-eu-west-1-spot
```
Priya: tagging infra-sre: the scale down looks immediate after healthcheck fail. We might need to extend drain grace to 45s for spot pools. Spot preemptions + aggressive drain => brief 502s.
Diego: +1 on grace. Also noticed AZ imbalance in ap-southeast-1 last night — one AZ had only 40% of the GPUs up because of quota enforcement on the account. That caused routing to route more to eu-west and bumped latencies.
Marta: PR for quota request in cloud-console is still pending (REQ-4521). I added the usage graph and justification. ops-bot, any ETA on review?
ops-bot: Notice: quota request REQ-4521 submitted to Cloud Team on 2026-03-16 22:03 UTC. Current status: pending. Estimated review SLA: 48-72 hours.
Sam: thanks — in the meantime we can shift some warmup traffic by adjusting routing weight, quick patch: set apac fallback weight from 0.6 -> 0.45 for eu-west to take some pressure off.
Priya: can someone run a simulated prewarm with spot eviction in ap-southeast-1 and confirm cache warm success? I can coordinate a small test.
Ava: I can run it at 14:00 UTC. Command I'm going to run: `./scripts/prewarm --region ap-southeast-1 --instances 6 --mode burn`
Diego: FYI I will monitor queue length + tail latency, will post numbers. If quota doesn't land we should prepare to shift some canaries to dedicated pools.
Marta: also opening a follow-up ticket to add a short circuit fallback when router sees >5% 502 over 1m — route to dedicated instead of retrying.
Sam: ack on ticket, can you drop the link when created?
Marta: ticket opened: INF-8793 -> https://tickets.internal/INF-8793
Priya: small note — model rollout tomorrow morning for rtx-quantized v2.0, need to ensure eu-west prewarm completes or canary will fail over.
Ava: noted, will prioritize the 14:00 test and follow up with pass/fail in this thread.
Diego: if we see spot evictions >2 in the test, I'll trigger reroute to dedicated manually and ping support.
Sam: no blockers from my side, I'll look at the router drain timings and propose a small change.
Ava: thanks all — will report back after the test. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Alert suppressed: scheduled prewarm test at 14:00 UTC. Reminder will send at 13:55 UTC.
